description: Source code for MailboxVideoFrameConverter class, handling GPU memory buffer conversions and shared image management in Chromium's media GPU component for ChromeOS.

classes.name: GpuDelegateImpl
classes.description: Implementation of GpuDelegate interface managing GPU channel and shared image creation, update, and synchronization.

classes.name: MailboxVideoFrameConverter::ScopedSharedImage
classes.description: Wrapper for shared image resources that ensures destruction callback is called on the GPU task runner.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a MailboxVideoFrameConverter instance with necessary callbacks and parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the converter with parent task runner and output callback.

methods.name: ConvertFrame
methods.description: Converts a GPU memory buffer VideoFrame into a shared image and outputs it.

methods.name: AbortPendingFrames
methods.description: Clears the queue of pending frames.

methods.name: HasPendingFrames
methods.description: Checks if there are frames pending conversion.
